description: Fourteen buttons sending gates: seven that latch on and off, and seven that are high only while they are held

params.text: Sends 10V while it is held down and 0V as soon as it is released, and lights while it is held
Latches its output between 10V and 0V on each press, and lights while the output is at 10V

outputs.text: Carries 10V while its button is held down, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while its latching button is on, and 0V while it is off

notes: the upper group of seven buttons latches and the lower group of seven is momentary; the panel prints nothing that says which is which
the seven latching buttons keep their on and off states when the patch is saved and reopened
